Hi sender. People kinda considered me extrovert and outgoing pero tbh, I don't feel the same way. During my time in college, specifically in 1st to 3rd year, I usually felt alone. Wala din naman akong friend na makausap on things running in my head. Not until I'm in my 4th and 5th year when I truly discovered my circle. Primary reason why I don't get that close to people is that I built my wall. I believe that the less they have access to us, the less they will be able to hurt us. Sabi ko pa nga, we only get hurt by the people we care, kaya pag-nakagawa talaga ng masakit yung mga tinuturing kong friend at walang apology and remorse, dinadamdam ko talaga.

This is unsolicited but I hope it helps: May mga araw talaga na you'll have to do things alone. Mag-lunch mag-isa, lumabas mag-isa, and even attend school events alone just because you don't feel close enough to other people. The trick is, you have to imagine yourself happy while doing things. I remember my classmate in college when we are trying to create an editorial article about extra-curricular activities in school that said, "Kaya man lang habo mag-attend kang ibang students sa mga event sa school is because they don't have friends to go with" and it's true. Ang hirap talaga mag traverse in college alone and it's hard to make yourself vulnerable to allow people get close to you. 

One thing I can be sure of sender is that, time will change you in a way that will surprise you. Who knows? Maybe sooner or later you'll get to know people who are truly your people. Maybe you'll find joy in solitude. Who knows? Only time will tell.

For now, whatever you're feeling, it's valid. Damdamin mo lang, but while you're feeling it, make an action towards it.

Posting a comment here because I got curious if 3rd cousin is considered incest, I don't care about the other content of this post.

Biologically, not incest.

Third cousins share ~0.78% DNA, compared to first cousins that share ~12.5% DNA. The cutoff for incest by % DNA is usually ~3.125%, which are second cousins.

Legally, also not incest.

According to Article 38(1) of the Family Code, a marriage are void if they are "Between collateral blood relatives, whether legitimate or illegitimate, up to the fourth civil degree" Which means marriage is considered incestuous and void up to first cousin which are 4th civil degree relatives, third cousins are 8th civil degree.
